scope: Step 8A human_verification_master.csv display-label to canonical taxonomy mapping decisions

decisions.rationale: Human verification uses display name 'Curry Leaf'; approved taxonomy canonical ID is 'curry_leaves'. This is a display-name/canonical-ID alias. Folder name typo ('Curry Leavf') is already documented in folder_class_mapping.json.
evidence: human_verification_master.csv has 114 reviewed records with Expected/Verified='Curry Leaf'

decisions.rationale: Preserve existing 'Garlic' label. Do not automatically map to 'garlic_clove' because the display label does not establish exact garlic form (clove/bulb vs processed/paste). Canonical mapping remains pending visual/provenance confirmation.
evidence: research/phase-13.3/annotation_pipeline/config/folder_class_mapping.json proposes 'garlic_clove' for folder 'Gralic' with rationale to confirm cloves/bulbs rather than paste
human_verification_master.csv has 599 reviewed records with Expected/Verified='Garlic'

decisions.rationale: Preserve existing 'Pepper Corn' label. Do not split into whole or ground pepper and do not force a canonical taxonomy mapping. Folder mapping is ambiguous_pending_review; manual review required before any canonical assignment.
evidence: research/phase-13.3/annotation_pipeline/config/approved_taxonomy.json contains 'black_pepper_whole' and 'black_pepper_ground' but no generic peppercorn class
research/phase-13.3/annotation_pipeline/config/folder_class_mapping.json marks 'Paper Corn' ambiguous_pending_review with candidate ['black_pepper_whole'] and requires visual review
human_verification_master.csv has 216 reviewed records with Expected/Verified='Pepper Corn'
